capability: Evaluate the fixed-pole Maxwellian dispersion approximation with its default order and declared failure contract.
operation: evaluate the fixed-pole Maxwellian dispersion function
discovery.boundary: Real axis is accepted; exponential continuation overflow raises.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for non-finite/empty phase points or an order below the supported pole count.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError when the pole sum exceeds finite float64 range; no fallback to a lower-order sum is selected.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Fixed J-pole approximation has no iterative convergence claim; the omitted-tail bound is not a certified global error.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial value is returned after a failed call.

scope: Default and explicit order, scalar/matrix shapes, reflection, normalization, positive imaginary axis overflow regression.
80-digit mpmath equation grid and 70-digit independent Gaussian Cauchy integrals.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the declared relation: Fixed tabulated partial-fraction approximation; upper-plane evaluation and Gaussian lower-plane reflection. Evidence: test_generalized_dispersion_faddeeva_variants.py, test_generalized_dispersion_faddeeva_independent.py (9 recorded test functions; shared-file coverage only; independent analytic/high-precision oracle); the contract example ran. Excluded scope: A guaranteed global error bound; An arbitrary distribution response.
known_limitations: Fixed truncation error depends on phase point and order.
Only shared-file coverage is bound (test_generalized_dispersion_faddeeva_variants.py); no asset-specific failure/limit probe is recorded.

title.zh: Maxwellian 固定极点色散近似

summary: Evaluate the fixed-pole Maxwellian dispersion approximation with its default order and declared failure contract.

identity.definition: Fixed tabulated partial-fraction approximation; upper-plane evaluation and Gaussian lower-plane reflection.
identity.boundary: Real axis is accepted; exponential continuation overflow raises.

supported: Finite nonempty scalar or array input; shape preserved.
preconditions: All phase values and computed results fit complex128.

inputs.name: order
inputs.description: Rational truncation or pole count. Explicit None is invalid.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_maxwellian_jpole
import numpy as np
r=evaluate_maxwellian_jpole(0.2+0.7j)
assert np.isfinite(r["Z"])
example.expected: Observed PASS: Finite complex response at the effective order.

references: Weideman (1994), Computation of the Complex Error Function, doi:10.1137/0731077
Xie (2013), Generalized Plasma Dispersion Function, arXiv:1305.6476
